testMatrix: MATCH: linked successful final deposit/fill and semantic recipient/action matches goal.
DIVERGED: linked receipts but effective recipient/action conflicts with declared goal.
INDETERMINATE: malformed/unknown/reverted/non-final/noncanonical receipt, missing event, wrong chain, wrong owner, unlinked deposit ID, RPC failure, or invalid consensus schema.
Conflict: deposit/fill with mismatched deposit ID, origin/destination chain, depositor, relay fields, or base message commitment is rejected before semantic judgment.
Adversarial audit: unaffiliated caller cannot overwrite or lock an intent; each caller can submit an independent nonce and immutable assessment receipt.
Replay: repeated intent or assessment nonce is rejected; a fresh nonce allows a new independent assessment.
Prompt injection: hostile goal text is treated as untrusted data; untrusted Across message bytes are not forwarded to the LLM.
